dogecoin.text:
Turns out a Chinese developer was trying to rival Dogecoin on its launch in 2013 with a "Kittycoin".

Cats have been part of Chinese culture for centuries, originally valued for protecting food stores from pests. Over time, they became symbols of peace, balance, and good fortune. https://t.co/1S1vhrdfgY

found this 4chan Japanese memecoin called "Monacoin" from 2014 https://t.co/E0MrajKvbC

the mascot was simply a cute cat and the mission was to replace Dogecoin

had a large Japanese community behind it, likely one of Japan's first ever memecoins with threads full of cute cat https://t.co/jmkqhZP3Qb

in 2014, the first Dogecoin related community was formed named the 'Diggers'.

This originated from a mining program called DogeDiggers, after which the community formed and became a very well respected name within the r/Dogecoin subreddit.

Hundreds of memes to show for this, https://t.co/VOyZilLbOm
